_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#8, confirming the corrected template and adding the asymmetry the entry omits. Upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml keeps its fields on disjoint node ids: DNODE 1 = fluid nodes 13-16 with a NUMDOF 4 Dirichlet, DNODE 2 = structure nodes 17-20 with a NUMDOF 3 Dirichlet. Adding one topology row 'NODE 13 DNODE 2' puts a 4-dof fluid node inside the structure's 3-entry condition and aborts before time step 1 with '3 DOFs given but 4 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition' from core/fem/src/discretization/4C_fem_discretization_utils_dbc.cpp line 292 inside Core::FE::Dbc::read_dirichlet_condition -- which is itself the proof that a DESIGN condition is evaluated against every discretisation owning its nodes. The mirror edit 'NODE 17 DNODE 1' (a 3-dof structure node inside the fluid's 4-entry condition) is accepted in silence: exit 0, 10 time steps, OK (6), zero DOF complaints, because the guard is `if (num_dbc_dofs < numdf)`. The retired wording 'NUMDOF mismatch'/'4C_dofset.cpp' appears in neither arm. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: 3 DOFs given but 4 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition
